set.body:
Problem: ResponseFunctional is linear only (Basis.scala:219) and NonlinearResponseSummary has only PeakLatency (:259). There is no signed amplitude summary for multi-column bases, such as sign(b1)*sqrt(sum b^2) for SPMG2/3.

Consumer need: the studio contrast inspector's amplitude readout for informed bases (G14).

Acceptance:
- A named nonlinear summary with documented definition and sign convention, verified against an independent calculation on JVM and JS.
- Its result is labelled as descriptive (no inference attached).

Out of scope: inference on the summary.
Provenance: verified read-only 2026-10-08 against ScalaFIM main ea6fe3ad for the PLS Neuro model studio (plsneuro review bd-01M4DMGP1QFSQX9Z5V91B4B12F; spec docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and GRAMMAR-NEEDS.md on plsneuro main).
set.title: Signed amplitude summary for multi-column response bases
